snippet.title: JustThoughtLounge
snippet.description:
True crime with just the facts. No speculation or commentary; you make up your own mind. This is Just Thought Lounge: the true crime channel based on unbiased storytelling.

Each week, Kevin takes viewers step-by-step through the evidence of a recent case; placing you in the shoes of the investigator, through to a seat in the jury box. At JTL, there is no hidden agenda. But we are all about opinions! Not ours, but yours. 

Join us in the lounge where you can sit back, put your feet up and contemplate.
